structural_change: s81_a2f_control4_resetlocal: actual control4 TT-109ps reset qualification moved after prefix; binary carry prefix replaced by monotone threshold merge to remove remaining CTS-2.9ps data->overflow path; ID priority mux replaced with onehot OR. Full53/4quarters/3slots unchanged; zero added cycles. Native launch/capture budgets tightened, no firm output hold chain. | r2 (S-VM 2210): r1 routed TT +46.1 / FF -5.95 / DRC 0 (s81_a2f_control4_resetlocal_pilot_2118_r1-split4-COMMIT-014095727): every reg D pin FF >= +8.01; the ONLY hold fails are 5 output ports ids[136,144,553,582,32] (-5.95..-0.27 ps) driven QN->INV->output BUFx2 straight from their dedicated pin registers, because r1 had outhold false (no pin hold pad on outputs) and the post-route ECO cannot add one at the port (least-bad FF -16.92). Fix = the recipe pin hold pad on every output (outhold true, HB1xp67, the weakest HB cell, same as inputs): a fixed boundary delay at every output, zero cycles, same RTL/pins/outline/root. | r3: r2 (2b4d4dbe2) routed TT +40.06 / FF -6.73 / DRC 0 with the HB1 output pad: reg D FF >= +18.16, only ids outputs fail (worst ids[251] -6.73): their launch flops sit on early clock leaves (146.8 ps vs IO reference L_min ~157), so clk->pin BUFx4f+HB1+BUFx2 = 78 ps < 85 ps needed. r3 = recipe-default HB2 output pad (out_cell), inputs keep HB1; zero cycles.
